fact: The Ministry of Communication, Telecommunications and Digital Economy published the National AI Strategy and Roadmap in 2023, with four objectives to 2028, six orientations and 52 actions, and foresees an AI cluster by end 2025, a public AI fund and an AI regulatory body and ethics committee.
title: Stratégie nationale et feuille de route du Sénégal sur l'Intelligence Artificielle
publisher: Ministère de la Communication, des Télécommunications et de l'Économie Numérique
